### Headline summary
- US export restrictions have forced Nvidia to halt server shipments to Southeast Asia and reject Chinese rental capacity. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p45#a261125p45), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-26/us-chip-curbs-stall-asia-data-center-financing-video))
- The FCC has approved SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million solar-powered satellites to build an orbital AI data center by 2040. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/spacex-gets-us-nod-to-deploy-1-million-satellites-for-orbital-ai-data-centres), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2329071/spacex-gets-fcc-approval-to-deploy-1-million-satellites-for-its-ai-orbital-data-center/))
- SAP is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the AI era. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-26/sap-weighs-cutting-at-least-10-000-positions-in-ai-restructuring), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261126/p22#a261126p22))

### US chip export curbs impact Nvidia and Asian data centers
US export restrictions on advanced AI chips have led Nvidia to halt server shipments to Southeast Asia and reject Chinese rental capacity, while investigations reveal that some US-based partners have ties to Chinese firms and that Asian data center financing is stalling. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261125/p45#a261125p45), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-26/us-chip-curbs-stall-asia-data-center-financing-video), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261126/p2#a261126p2), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/ft-nvidia-turns-down-south-asian-shipments-after-new-us-chip-curbs))

### FCC approves SpaceX deployment of 1 million AI satellites
The FCC has granted SpaceX approval to deploy up to 1 million solar-powered satellites to build an orbital AI data center by 2040. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/spacex-gets-us-nod-to-deploy-1-million-satellites-for-orbital-ai-data-centres), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2329071/spacex-gets-fcc-approval-to-deploy-1-million-satellites-for-its-ai-orbital-data-center/), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gBLJYK-js9E), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/fcc-clears-spacex-to-deploy-up-to-1-million-starmind-satellites-for-orbital-ai-data-centers-by-2040/))

### SAP plans to cut 10,000 jobs for AI transformation
SAP is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions, or 9% of its global staff, to transform its software business for the AI era. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-26/sap-weighs-cutting-at-least-10-000-positions-in-ai-restructuring), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261126/p22#a261126p22))

### Anthropic Claude updates and internal developments
Anthropic has released updates to its Claude AI model, including new capabilities and pricing changes, while also reporting that the model helped rebuild its API in Rust to reduce CPU usage and that AI is influencing how engineers are promoted within the company. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-anthropic-claude-messages-api-rust-migration/), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/stop-paying-20-a-month-for-claude-fable-5-2-youre-not-even-buying-it-ec54d67273b0?source=rss----98111c9905da---4), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/ai-changing-engineering-promotions-anthropic-2026-11), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/anthropic-just-changed-ai-coding-forever-heres-what-claude-can-do-now-07d81929a395?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))

### Microsoft details state-backed use of ARTEX AI tool
Microsoft reported that state-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, have added the AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their arsenals. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261126/p3#a261126p3), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/microsoft-details-how-state-backed-hackers-use-the-artex-ai-framework-to-automate-cyberattacks/))

### New York bans AI chatbot toys for children
New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law imposing a five-year ban on the sale of AI chatbot toys for kids following concerns about rogue behavior. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/25/new-york-bans-ai-toys-amid-concern-after-stuffed-animals-going-rogue/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2328996/new-york-state-bans-ai-chatbot-toys-for-kids/))

### Chinese AI developers distill from Google and Meta models
Chinese AI companies Z.AI and Moonshot AI are reportedly turning to Google and Meta models for distillation after delays in their own flagship model development. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/after-openai-and-anthropic-shut-the-door-on-their-data-a-chinese-ai-developer-is-turning-to-google-and-meta-instead/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/moonshot-ai-begins-distilling-from-google-and-meta-models-amid-delays/))

### Google expands AI agent access to productivity apps
Google is expanding the capabilities of its AI agents to access Gmail, Drive, and Docs, while also enabling its AI Mode to read user wallet data with Drive integration coming next. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-google-workspace-ai-agent-access/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/26/googles-ai-mode-can-now-read-your-wallet-with-drive-coming-next/))
